description.zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
description.en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or temporary authorization with STS.

description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: The organization ID. Get this ID from the URL of your organization page in Alibaba Cloud DevOps. Example: https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}

description.zh:
页码 
默认值为1，从第1页开始
description.en: The page number. Pages are numbered starting from 1. Defaults to 1.

description.zh:
每页大小
默认值为20，取值范围【1,100】
description.en: The page size. Defaults to 20. Range: 1–100.

description.zh: 搜索关键字（匹配标签名称）
description.en: The search keyword to match against tag names.

description.zh:
排序方式，默认值为updated_desc
- updated_asc：更新时间，升序
- updated_desc：更新时间，降序
- name_asc：标签名称，升序
- name_desc：标签名称，降序
description.en:
The sort order. Defaults to updated\_desc.

- updated\_asc: Update time, ascending

- updated\_desc: Update time, descending

- name\_asc: Tag name, ascending

- name\_desc: Tag name, descending
